input: Find general day camps, Parks & Recreation camps, summer childcare, YMCA and Boys & Girls Club summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Brevard, Pisgah Forest, Rosman, Cedar Mountain, Lake Toxaway and Sapphire, NC (Transylvania County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Brevard Transylvania county summer day camp 2026 parks recreation

candidates.name: Transylvania County Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camps with games, activities and field trips; summer 2025 operation confirmed.

candidates.name: The Cindy Platt Boys & Girls Club of Transylvania County
candidates.note: Eight-week summer program for youth, Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: 2027 day camps at Brevard College and in Pisgah National Forest; teen leadership and backpacking programs also offered.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures for rising grades 1–7 ran July 20–24, 2026; also offers a residential high-school Choral Institute.

candidates.name: KE Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Toxaway, a traditional children's day camp at Lake Toxaway Country Club.

candidates.name: Sapphire Valley Master Association
candidates.note: Resort recreation provider offered a supervised children's afternoon art camp on July 15, 2025.

candidates.name: YMCA Camp Greenville
candidates.note: YMCA overnight summer camp for children and teens; summer 2026 programming confirmed.
